title: Persistent departures from pre-COVID HIV diagnosis trends in the EU/EEA, 2022–2024: code and data
description: R code, extracted public data (ECDC/WHO HIV/AIDS surveillance in Europe reports for data years 2015–2024; Eurostat dataset migr_asytpspop), result tables and figure code for the article 'Persistent departures from pre-COVID HIV diagnosis trends in the EU/EEA, 2022–2024: an ecological analysis by transmission category, sex, and country' (Remez D, Mori H, Krokva D, Lumjiaktase P, Frutos R, Cornillot E, Hadano Y, Itoh N, Naito T; submitted to BMC Public Health).
